def calculate_similarity_score(A, B):
    n, m = len(A), len(B)
    dp = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    lcs_length = [[""] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            if A[i - 1] == B[j - 1]:
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1
                lcs_length[i][j] = lcs_length[i - 1][j - 1] + A[i - 1]
            else:
                if dp[i - 1][j] > dp[i][j - 1]:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j]
                    lcs_length[i][j] = lcs_length[i - 1][j]
                else:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i][j - 1]
                    lcs_length[i][j] = lcs_length[i][j - 1]

    max_score = float('-inf')
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            lcs = lcs_length[i][j]
            score = 4 * len(lcs) - len(A) - len(B)
            max_score = max(max_score, score)

    return max_score

# Read input
n, m = map(int, input().split())
A = input().strip()
